item.title: Seeing at the Edge: Energy Characterization of Vision-Language Model Inference on Edge Platforms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 VLM 正走向边缘设备，但带 NPU/GPU 加速器的单板计算机上 VLM 能耗多少、耗在何处，此前知之甚少。

方法 在树莓派 5（Hailo-10H NPU）与 Jetson Orin Nano Super 上测量 Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct 及其纯文本版的系统总能耗、延迟与热行为，CPU 与加速器后端各测，并把能耗拆为每请求固定部分与随输出长度增长部分；因加速器量化与服务软件不同，比较的是部署栈而非芯片。

关键数字 NPU 卸载使树莓派每生成 token 能耗约降三分之二，并避免 CPU 后端持续运行时的热降频；图像输入增加固定与每 token 能耗，但典型响应长度下生成答案远比处理图像耗能；Jetson GPU 固定成本低、利于短响应，树莓派 NPU 每 token 成本低、利于长响应，两条能耗曲线在约 40 个输出 token 处相交。

为什么值得看 少见的边缘 VLM 系统能耗实测，"固定成本 vs token 成本"拆解对边缘多模态选型很实用。

item.title: Scaling LLM Inference via Parallelism: Throughput-Latency Trade-off
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 推理含决定首字延迟（TTFT）的 prefill 与决定逐字延迟（ITL）的 decode 两个本质不同的阶段，TP/PP/混合并行对两者的权衡各异，但不同负载与 SLO 下如何选并行配置缺乏系统理解。

方法 构建吞吐-延迟权衡的系统分析框架：通过构造 TTFT-ITL 可行集与 Pareto 前沿、提出"并行操作区域"概念刻画不同负载构成，并用 goodput 形式化 SLO 感知的并行选择。

关键数字 摘要未给实测数字，核心定性结论：负载越偏 prefill，最优配置从 TP 主导系统性迁移到 PP 主导；TTFT 要求严苛偏向 PP 主导，延迟约束宽松则转向容量更高的 TP 主导；长上下文中 PP 主导的扩展性与 SLO 达成更优。

为什么值得看 为分布式推理的并行配置选型给出系统性指导框架，做 serving 部署的团队值得参考。

item.title: STISA: A 0.16 GOPS/W/PE Single-Shot Inference FPGA-based SNN Accelerator with Algorithm and Hardware Co-Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 SNN 事件驱动、低功耗潜力大，但时间依赖带来推理延迟高、硬件利用率低；现有加速器难以兼顾时间步、精度与能效，面向硬件的时间步压缩研究不足。

方法 STISA 算法-硬件协同设计框架：时间分裂压缩（TSC）以时间分裂结构削减时间冗余；时间优先输出驻留（TPOS）映射 + Block-Mux 流式（BMS）架构实现硬件高效的时空并行；TSC-TPOS-BMS 联合优化配合带宽感知资源分配。

关键数字 TSC 削减 24.44%–51.71% 突触操作，CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100/ImageNet/DVS-CIFAR10 精度分别 96.38%/81.10%/68.51%/82.40%；FPGA 原型最高 7.99 倍加速、30.4% 功耗降低、30.1% LUT 减少；整体达 0.16 GOPS/W/PE。

为什么值得看 SNN 时间步压缩与硬件协同的完整范例，能效数据齐全，对边缘低功耗推理有参考价值。

item.title: Progress-Aware Distillation for Mitigating Stagnation in Small Language Model Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 用蒸馏把 agent 能力迁移到小模型（SLM）时，随交互轨迹变长，学生模型易出现"进展停滞"：困在反复失败的策略循环里难以推进，该现象跨模型、跨任务域普遍存在。

方法 提出进度感知蒸馏（ProD）：显式检测学生生成轨迹中的停滞并施加惩罚，把学生与教师之间的停滞差距编码为自适应裕度，动态惩罚潜在停滞行为；迭代施加该过程使学生逐步逼近教师行为。

关键数字 在 0.6B–8B 的 8 个 SLM、域内与域外基准上，ProD 显著缓解进展停滞，同时提升蒸馏 SLM agent 的成功率与任务完成效率（摘要未给具体百分比）。

为什么值得看 指出小模型 agent 蒸馏的一个共性失效模式并给出训练侧解法，做低成本 agent 的团队值得参考。

item.title: Parallel Sparse Outputs for Tensor Compilers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 稀疏张量编译器是优化稀疏数据上张量代数程序的常用工具，但并行稀疏张量编译器研究极少：已有方法要么无法并行，要么对访问模式/输出格式做了限制通用性的假设。

方法 提出 Birdseed：首个支持任意标准稀疏格式、全部循环次序并行化的张量编译器；支持并行稀疏 scatter，可直接写入 fibertree 稀疏格式的 list、bytemap、hash 与 dense 层级。

关键数字 相对所有先前工作在内存与时间上均有渐近改进；在 histogram 构造、SpMSpV 等公认难并行的核上展示了实测加速（摘要未给具体倍数）。

为什么值得看 补齐并行稀疏张量编译器这块空白，做稀疏计算与编译器的高性能方向值得跟进。

阅读原文

item.title: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长输出推理受 KV cache 内存与带宽瓶颈制约；2-bit 低比特量化严重损害精度，已有混合精度 key cache 方法仅凭 key 统计估计通道重要性。

方法 在 RoPE 通道对层面做注意力 logit 扰动分析，发现 query-key 对范数积大的通道对上量化误差对 logit 波动贡献显著；据此提出 PN-Mix：把更高精度分配给显著通道对，一次在 prefill 阶段识别、整个解码阶段复用。

关键数字 平均 2.26-bit 精度下，平均准确率持平或优于使用 2.32–2.39 bit 的已有混合精度方法（推理、代码生成、AIME 基准）；Pareto 扫描中可平滑降至 1.5 bit，而对比基线在 2.25 bit 以下明显跳水。

为什么值得看 为低比特 KV 量化给出可操作的通道对显著性判据，对推理/代码等长输出场景尤其有用。

item.title: Memory-Efficient Subspace Optimization with Residual Correction: From Momentum SGD to Muon
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 内存高效子空间优化可降低 LLM 训练内存成本，但已有算法依赖随机梯度的主奇异子空间，训练后期梯度噪声可能主导子空间、阻碍收敛。

方法 采用残差校正框架：优化器状态维持在子空间内，正交残差梯度加回参数更新；与动量 SGD 结合得 SMRC（引入子空间虚拟迭代解开动量与残差校正的耦合），与 Muon 结合得 PMRC（对投影动量施加矩阵符号）；两者均设计周期性重算基的多阶段变体，并用边界校正保持虚拟迭代跨阶段一致。

关键数字 SMRC 与 PMRC 分别证得 O(T^-1/4) 收敛率，与全空间动量 SGD、全空间 Muon 持平；多阶段变体保持同阶速率；实验确认有效性与效率（摘要未给具体内存节省数字）。

为什么值得看 为"动量 SGD 到 Muon"的子空间省内存训练补齐收敛理论，做大模型训练内存优化方向值得读。

阅读原文

item.title: MFSA: A Multi-Format Systolic Array with Native Micro Scaling Support
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 AI 负载混合使用 BF16/FP8/FP4/MX/INT 等多种低精度格式，硬件需灵活且高效地原生支持。

方法 MFSA 是权重驻留的多格式脉动阵列：PE 级用由开源跨精度 FPU 扩展的 DPA-PE，以共享数据通路支持 FP32 到 INT4 并按格式比例扩展吞吐；阵列级用在线块尺度重定基（OBSR），在块边界把块尺度折入 FP32 部分和，无需第二套跨块累加器。

关键数字 TSMC 28nm、1GHz 下，BF16/FP8/FP4 级联基线面积是单格式 DPA-PE 的 1.5/2.5/4.5 倍；16×16 MFSA 峰值 0.5/1/2/4 TOPS（FP32/BF16/FP8/FP4）；OBSR 相对朴素 MX 实现省 64.2% 面积、67.5% 能耗；在 BF16+CFP8 基线上补全其余格式仅多 25.7% 面积，支持 NVFP4 额外代价为 11.8% 面积、7.3% 功耗。

为什么值得看 多格式低精度阵列设计的完整工程范例，关注 MX/NVFP4 生态的架构设计者值得细读。

阅读原文

item.title: LatentLoop: Scaling Looped MoE Models with Asymmetric Compute Allocation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 循环 MoE 以参数复用 + 稀疏计算在相同预算下提升性能，但共享参数的各次循环访问作用不同，计算应如何按角色分配尚不清楚。

方法 通过学习独立残差系数发现第一次访问尺度更小、且降低第一次访问尺度不损害甚至改善性能（第二次则相反）；据此提出 LatentLoop：压缩第一次访问的序列长度、第二次保持全分辨率，把省下的计算转投更大隐藏维度；循环间共享 MoE 权重、注意力参数独立以适配不同序列分辨率。

关键数字 1.3B–7B 参数、15 种配置（最大预算超 10^21 FLOPs）下一致降低验证 NLL；在拟合 NLL 1.988 处，相对 vanilla MoE 与循环基线分别预计节省 19.0%、7.9% 计算量，并在 9 个基准的 0-shot/5-shot 下全尺寸提升平均分。

为什么值得看 给出循环架构下"非对称算力分配"的可落地方案，对权重复用与循环网络设计方向有参考意义。

阅读原文
item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 循环 MoE 以参数复用 + 稀疏计算在相同预算下提升性能，但共享参数的各次循环访问作用不同，计算应如何按角色分配尚不清楚。

方法 通过学习独立残差系数发现第一次访问尺度更小、且降低第一次访问尺度不损害甚至改善性能（第二次则相反）；据此提出 LatentLoop：压缩第一次访问的序列长度、第二次保持全分辨率，把省下的计算转投更大隐藏维度；循环间共享 MoE 权重、注意力参数独立以适配不同序列分辨率。

关键数字 1.3B–7B 参数、15 种配置（最大预算超 10^21 FLOPs）下一致降低验证 NLL；在拟合 NLL 1.988 处，相对 vanilla MoE 与循环基线分别预计节省 19.0%、7.9% 计算量，并在 9 个基准的 0-shot/5-shot 下全尺寸提升平均分。

为什么值得看 给出循环架构下"非对称算力分配"的可落地方案，对权重复用与循环网络设计方向有参考意义。

item.title: JointServe: Serving Multi-Model Agents on Memory-Constrained GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM agent 从单模型调工具演进为编排多个专家模型，模型工作集超出显存；在私有/边缘的显存受限 GPU 上，整模型换入换出会把传输与计算串行，且丢失会话状态。

方法 JointServe 把权重分片与 KV 块统一为共享同一内存预算的驻留对象，利用 agent 负载的定向调用、间隙执行、双态驻留三个结构性质：从调用方输出流解析意图信号、在生成期间触发预取；部分 k* 驻留把切换降为增量换层；抢占式传输调度器以保证带宽份额保护活跃会话 KV，另有控制步骤动态调整权重/KV 分配。

关键数字 会话完成时间比最强整模型换页基线低 21.7%；在所有整模型基线都无法完成的崩溃场景中保持可用（46 倍差距）；回放 SWE-bench、tau-bench、OSWorld 轨迹时完成时间最多降 49%，SLO 达成率从 2.8–24.5% 升至 76.8–100%。

为什么值得看 面向多模型 agent 这一新范式的 serving 系统，显存受限设备部署 agent 的团队值得跟进。

item.title: How the Dirty Set Moves: Characterizing Schedule Reuse in Incremental Sparse Matrix Multiplication
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 稀疏矩阵固定、每步仅少数输入行变化（dirty set）的增量稀疏矩阵乘可复用结果，但 inspector-executor 的分块调度在 dirty set 移动后何时仍有利，此前缺乏系统刻画。

方法 在 21 个 SuiteSparse 矩阵与受控的 dirty set 移动模式上，系统比较增量更新、调度复用（分块执行器 + 缓存调度）与全量重算代码。

关键数字 直接按列增量更新比 8 种全量重算实现（含 Intel oneMKL、PyTorch）中最好者快 2.1–8.2 倍；在 837 个工作负载中 779 个优于保留分块调度的执行器；收益来自分块预处理而非调度缓存；仅当分块能把多个非零元合并进同一次输出写时才更快——该结构性质可在测量前预测。

为什么值得看 为增量稀疏计算"何时值得做调度复用"划出清晰边界，对稀疏运行时开发者是实用指南。

item.title: Energy Consumption Analysis of Discrete Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 推理能耗日益关键；扩散语言模型（DLLM）支持并行生成，是与自回归（AR）模型并行的路线，但两者缺乏系统的能耗对比。

方法 对扩散模型（LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B）与 AR 模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B）做对照式能耗基准测试，分析模型架构、KV-cache 优化与每 token 焦耳（J/token）效率之间的权衡。

关键数字 200–600 token 较长序列下，扩散模型能耗 2.5–2.7 J/token，约为带 KV-cache 的 AR 模型（5.3–5.7 J/token）的 1/2；KV-cache 在长序列下为 AR 模型降低 50–70% 能耗。

为什么值得看 为"扩散 vs 自回归"给出直接的每 token 能耗证据，对绿色推理与部署选型有参考价值。

item.title: ESL-former: Event Sparse Linear Transformer for FPGA-Accelerated Malware Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 基于 Transformer 的恶意软件检测有潜力，但自注意力的计算与内存成本使其难以部署到资源受限的边缘 FPGA。

方法 提出事件稀疏线性 Transformer（ESL-former）：不构造显式注意力矩阵，直接从 Linear Transformer 累积的键值状态推导 token 与通道重要性；贡献感知打分函数度量各 token/通道对线性注意力状态的扰动，剪掉冗余；硬件上用 Top-K 活跃 token 缓冲与压缩单元替代二值掩码执行，将活跃 token/通道重组为稠密定长数据流，让处理单元执行规则乘累加。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体量化指标，结论为在保持恶意软件分类精度的同时降低硬件成本。

为什么值得看 把 Transformer 安全检测落到功耗敏感的边缘 FPGA，线性注意力 + 稀疏化 + 硬件重组的协同设计值得借鉴。

item.title: CacheSmith: Accurate RAG Serving under Latency SLOs with Adaptive KV Reuse
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 RAG prefill 中复用检索块的预计算 KV 可降低延迟，但会漏掉跨块注意力；已有选择性重算方案采用静态一刀切配置，无法应对请求异质性与动态延迟预算。

方法 CacheSmith 把选择性重算分解为 WarmUp、Probe、Patch 三阶段，可动态配置以覆盖宽范围的成本-精度权衡；服务时由 SLO 感知调度器组批降低请求间干扰，预算感知规划器跨批次配置重算阶段，两组件均基于剖析得到的成本-精度带做免求解器快速决策。

关键数字 在 4 个基准、不同到达率与突发度下，质量门控 SLO 达成率较四个 SOTA 基线最高提升 27.5%。

为什么值得看 针对 RAG 服务"精度门控 + 延迟 SLO"联合目标的系统设计，做 RAG 推理服务的团队可直接参考。

item.title: CAFE: Conducting-Cell-Aware Adaptive Differential Encoding for Robust DNN Inference in FeFET-Based Compute-in-Memory
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 FeFET 存算一体（CIM）做 DNN 推理时器件偏差会严重降低位切片精度；FeFET 关态漏电可忽略、误差由导通态单元主导，且二进制补码符号扩展会把小负值映射到高位切片、放大误差。

方法 提出 CAFE 导通单元感知自适应差分编码框架：定义按位显著性加权的导通单元活性度量 C²AM 预测精度退化，用差分权重/激活编码消除符号扩展引起的放大效应；通过类型级枚举、层级 NSGA-II 搜索与后剪枝在鲁棒性-成本间分配编码。

关键数字 C²AM 最高降低 28.6 倍；主部署研究中精度较补码 CIM 提升超 87 个百分点；归一化成本 1.86–2.78 倍，低于均匀全差分编码的 3.06 倍。

为什么值得看 器件机理感知的编码-硬件协同设计，为 FeFET CIM 的鲁棒部署给出新的成本权衡思路。

阅读原文

item.title: Beyond Expert Rankings: Contrast Calibration for Mixed-Precision MoE Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 MoE 语言模型每 token 只激活少数专家，但全部专家权重都需存储；混合精度量化可降低存储成本，但仅凭专家排序无法确定各专家误差应加多强的权重。

方法 提出 NatScale 对比校准分配框架：用模型特定的幂变换把基于梯度的专家权重校准到信息论对比目标、同时保留排序；联合评估每个专家的 gate/up/down 配置估计输出误差，再结合基于权重谱、方差与精度衰减的先验，在存储预算下选择配置。

关键数字 3 个模型、5 种分配基线对比下，NatScale 在全部 9 个设置中取得最低原生-量化 KL 散度与最高 top-token 一致性，其中 7 个设置困惑度最低。

为什么值得看 指出"目标感知"的精度分配优于单纯专家排序，对 MoE 低比特部署有直接参考价值。

item.title: AMAX: Accuracy-Aware Multi-Loop Asymmetric Perforation for Heterogeneous Architectures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 异构多核系统受热约束制约，DVFS 与任务迁移在高负载下开销大；近似计算中的循环穿孔可减少计算量，但现有方法对所有循环施加统一穿孔率，忽略了各循环的敏感度差异。

方法 提出 AMAX 精度感知多循环非对称穿孔框架：通过逐循环剖析与多目标配置选择压缩组合设计空间，得到非对称穿孔配置，并在运行时按性能需求动态调整配置。

关键数字 在 PARSEC 基准上，相同性能目标下归一化精度相对对称穿孔最高提升 0.85。

为什么值得看 给出"剖析-选择-运行时调节"的完整循环级近似计算流程，对异构平台热约束下的精度感知优化有直接借鉴意义。

item.title: pi-Net: Empirical Latent Representations for Differentiable Physics Heads in Data-Scarce Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Developing reliable predictive models for multi-physics systems often forces a compromise between computationally demanding physical simulators and data-hungry, opaque machine learning (ML) algorithms.

Developing reliable predictive models for multi-physics systems often forces a compromise between computationally demanding physical simulators and data-hungry, opaque machine learning (ML) algorithms. While incorporating dimensional analysis into directed computation graphs offers a structurally sound alternative to explicitly solving partial differential equations (PDEs), such formulations typically yield underdetermined systems that act as imperfect simulators. We introduce pi-Net, a physics-informed latent variable model that resolves these imperfect simulators. The hybrid pi-Net architecture consists of an encoder that maps inputs into physically normalized latent space, which are then decoded into final predictions by a differentiable physics head. Evaluated on a real-world, data-scarce Gas Metal Arc Welding (GMAW) case study, the framework achieves an R2 of 0.864 with only 60 experimental samples. The results demonstrate that pi-Net significantly outperforms purely data-driven baselines in data-scarce regimes while providing causal, process-level explainability.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: inLoRA-MINT: Internal Representations for Auditing Training Data in Domain-adapted LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

This work investigates the application of the Membership Inference Test (MINT) to large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA, aiming to determine whether specific samples were used during training and address concerns about data privacy, leakage, and transparency.

This work investigates the application of the Membership Inference Test (MINT) to large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA, aiming to determine whether specific samples were used during training and address concerns about data privacy, leakage, and transparency. Building on our previous LoRA-MINT framework, which relies exclusively on perplexity under a strict black-box setting, we propose an approach based on intermediate model representations, including activations and parameter-dependent signals. These representations enable a MINT classifier to distinguish training from non-training samples without requiring full access to model parameters. We evaluated the method on four LLMs (Qwen, Phi-4, DeepSeek-V3, and LLaMA 3.2-3B) fine-tuned on three datasets covering medical, mathematical, and academic reasoning tasks. Results show consistent performance across architectures and domains, achieving scores between 95% and 98%, with robustness to variations in model configurations and data distributions. The proposed approach enables efficient auditing of sensitive training data and supports data provenance and compliance with emerging privacy and AI governance regulations. Althou…

item.title: Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of LLMs in Learnable Low-Rank Subspaces
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs).

Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). However, ZO optimization suffers from high variance in high-dimensional parameter spaces. While recent methods restrict perturbations to random low-rank subspaces, these subspaces often misalign with task-specific descent directions. We propose AdaSub-ZO, a novel forward-only fine-tuning framework in learnable low-rank subspaces. Instead of relying on fixed random matrices, AdaSub-ZO iteratively learns layer-wise projection matrices directly from finite-difference feedback to track task-aware descent directions. Furthermore, AdaSub-ZO incorporates a subspace momentum acceleration mechanism to smooth noisy gradient estimates across evolving subspace bases. Extensive experiments on natural language understanding tasks demonstrate that AdaSub-ZO outperforms existing ZO baselines, substantially reducing gradient estimation variance and accelerating convergence.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: ZOIF: Zeroth-Order Influence Function Estimation for LLM Data Selection Using Only Forward Passes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Influence functions enable principled data selection for large language models (e.g., identifying influential training samples for model editing, debugging, or efficient fine-tuning).

Influence functions enable principled data selection for large language models (e.g., identifying influential training samples for model editing, debugging, or efficient fine-tuning). However, scaling IFs to LLMs is hindered by the intractability of billion-scale Hessian matrices and the prohibitive memory overhead of backpropagation (BP). While many classical IF approximations reduce Hessian complexity, they still rely on BP for gradient computation, requiring massive storage for intermediate activations that impedes practical data selection at scale. To address this, we propose ZOIF, a zeroth-order framework for influence estimation that operates entirely via forward passes, enabling memory-efficient data selection under resource constraints. ZOIF decomposes influence estimation into three BP-free stages: (1) approximating the average proxy gradient via zeroth-order estimation; (2) reformulating and solving the inverse Hessian-vector product as an auxiliary zeroth-order optimization to bypass explicit inversion; and (3) deriving per-sample influence scores via a forward finite difference along the previously computed parameter update direction. Although post-training significantly enhances model performance, the use of massive undisclosed data raises concerns about benchmark contamination and copyright infringement. This drives growing interest in training data detection for post-trained models. Existing evaluations for training data detection often leverage benchmarks constructed post hoc, which can introduce distribution shifts. item.title: When Sparsity Breaks Connectivity: Functional Reachability and Guided Topology Dynamics in Extreme Sparse Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) periodically prunes and regrows connections, inducing a discrete dynamical mechanism over network topologies.

Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) periodically prunes and regrows connections, inducing a discrete dynamical mechanism over network topologies. At extreme sparsity ($\ge 99\%$), this dynamic tends to destroy input-output information pathways, and performance with standard magnitude/random updates degrades sharply. We formalize forward, backward, and functional reachability on layered sparse graphs, derive closed-form expectations for reachable neurons and edges, and show that Monte Carlo realizations match the theory. Guided by this reachability-based structure, we bias pruning toward non-functional edges and regrowth toward functionally consistent candidates. We introduce this reachability-driven modification of topology evolution as Reachability-guided in DST, referred to as guided DST. On CIFAR-10/100 and Tiny ImageNet, guided DST recovers large accuracy gaps versus unguided DST (up to $+14.4$ points at $99.9\%$ sparsity on CIFAR-100), and on MLP-Mixer guided DST remains trainable at $99.99\%$ sparsity while unguided random regrowth degrades sharply. These results cast extreme-sparse training as a connectivity-preserving dynamical process. Our implementation is publicly available at…

item.description:

Large AI models increasingly rely on distributed GPU execution, yet it remains unclear whether established failure analysis methods transfer effectively to this setting. We introduce GF-Bench, a PyTorch-based framework and dataset for generating diverse failures in distributed GPU workloads. The framework supports extensible workload and fault-injection logic; based on this design, the current release targets failures visible in multi-GPU communication logs and provides 220 labeled two-GPU executions covering normal runs, CUDA out-of-memory fail-stop failures, and persistent straggler fail-slow failures. Using GF-Bench, we evaluate three sequence-based methods (DeepLog, LogAnomaly, and LogBERT) and the LLM-based LogPrompt on parsed logs, and additionally evaluate LogPrompt on raw logs. On parsed inputs, no method reliably detects both failure classes, and the highest overall F1 score is 0.667. Raw inputs raise the overall F1 score of in-context LogPrompt to 0.983, at 9.0x its average input-token usage and 8.7x its per-run cost. RTL-generation studies increasingly report functional correctness and post-synthesis quality, yet the evaluator itself is rarely treated as an experimental variable. A candidate can appear better when a security rule, protocol obligation, target context, feasibility gate, uncertainty policy, or provenance constraint is omitted. We introduce tool-grounded requirement profiles: machine-readable contracts binding each requirement's meaning to its executable evidence and comparison rule, together with cross-requirement gates, uncertainty handling, and provenance. We audit evaluator stability by freezing candidate pairs and perturbing only their evaluation profile. item.title: When Dynamic Scaling Fails: A Scale-State Feedback Governs Recurrent-State Quantization in Linear-Attention and SSM LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Linear-attention and state-space LLMs carry long context in a fixed-size recurrent state, and quantizing that state is the natural way to cut its cost during long decode.

Linear-attention and state-space LLMs carry long context in a fixed-size recurrent state, and quantizing that state is the natural way to cut its cost during long decode. Unlike a weight tensor, the state is rewritten at every step, so a quantizer applied at each step sits inside the recurrence and its errors compound. INT4 that leaves synthetic recall perfectly intact at the start destroys it a thousand steps later. The mechanism is a feedback between the quantizer scale and the state it is derived from. The remainder is a resolution problem that locating outliers does not solve, since every outlier-aware scheme here loses to plain persistent scaling. Layer-wise post-training quantization methods let each layer compensate for the quantization error inherited from earlier layers.

Layer-wise post-training quantization methods let each layer compensate for the quantization error inherited from earlier layers. We ask under what assumptions such compensation guarantees a network output error no larger than without it. For linear networks of any depth, with the required calibration Gram matrices invertible, if the rounding error of each layer has zero conditional mean and a deterministic second-moment map common to both schemes, as under subtractive dither on an unbounded grid, then compensation with strengths in $[0,1]$ fixed in advance gives a mean-square output error no larger than no compensation, each scheme being followed along its own trajectory. Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features are typically discovered from how their activations co-vary with behaviour, yet they are often used through interventions such as steering or ablation.

Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features are typically discovered from how their activations co-vary with behaviour, yet they are often used through interventions such as steering or ablation. We take intervention attribution, the first-order effect of a specified intervention on the model output, as our estimand. For a broad class of response functions, we show that observational feature-discovery evidence generally does not identify this attribution, and derive an exact gradient-based decomposition of the gap between linear-probe predictions and intervention attribution. Across four model-SAE pairs, median probe-to-attribution magnitude ratios range from tens to hundreds, while attributions closely track small-step steering. For single-latent ablations with nonzero effects, gradient predictions match the realized sign in 91-97% of cases, compared with 17-35% for probe-implied changes. Attribution-selected sets also produce larger absolute mean ablation effects on held-out prompts than sets selected by correlation, rank tests or probe coefficients. item.title: What Can Language Models Inherit from Solomonoff Induction? Limits, Attainable Properties, and What Served Conditionals Reveal
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

A familiar line of reasoning runs as follows: language models are flexible approximators trained under a strictly proper loss, so scale brings them closer to Solomonoff induction, and their predictive success is evidence of that approach.

A familiar line of reasoning runs as follows: language models are flexible approximators trained under a strictly proper loss, so scale brings them closer to Solomonoff induction, and their predictive success is evidence of that approach. We apply known results from algorithmic information theory, universal prediction and Bayesian consistency. In its uniform form the conclusion holds for no computable model: each has cheap environments it never learns, and every uniformly computable family of total predictors shares one on which each member fails beyond a horizon growing with its index, so ``closer'' can hold only pointwise, one environment at a time. Nor could the offered routes certify even that: finite evaluation cannot certify agreement on rarely reached contexts, perfect corpus fit selects the corpus law as prior, and asymptotic criteria cannot see the constants that carry Solomonoff's guarantee. Our lens is the Kraft inequality read for predictors. Every model has at most the same budget of predictive success, so Solomonoff's predictor, which leaves part of it unspent, differs from a language model not in having more of it but in where it spends it; on mutually singular famil…

item.title: Weighted Beeping Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Beeping Networks (BN) have become an established model of wireless communication and computation.

Beeping Networks (BN) have become an established model of wireless communication and computation. They assume, however, that the communication interference caused by beeping nodes is binary (OR channel), while both artificial and nature-driven networks are based on varied signal strength and receiving thresholds. This work naturally extends the classic beeping networks to weighted beeping networks (WBN), by modeling signal strengths by weights on graph edges and receiving a beep if the accumulative signal strengths of transmitting neighbors are above receiving threshold. Under this generalized model, we study the fundamental Local Broadcast (LB) problem. Since edges with low weights may not even accumulate to a received beep, we only require that messages are delivered along sufficiently heavy edges, with weights above some given threshold $σ$. item.title: WUSPruner: Second-Moment-Optimal Transforms for Structured Pruning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 结构化剪枝通常只问"删哪些维度"，但坐标删除的效果根本上取决于在哪个基下执行剪枝。

方法 WUSPruner 把基选择形式化为局部线性重建问题：由激活与权重统计联合构造的 WUS 变换最小化剪枝重建损失，同时将两者二阶矩对角化并平衡，使删除误差分解为独立谱贡献；实现用分块 WUS 变换与紧凑输入投影。

关键数字 摘要未给具体数值；在 Llama 与 Qwen 8B~72B 上，语言建模、知识、常识推理、数学与代码基准一致优于结构化剪枝基线，并带来实际时延与内存下降。

为什么值得看 正面回答"该在哪个基下剪"的理论问题，给出二阶矩意义下的最优变换，并有 72B 规模验证。

item.title: Vesta: Queueing-Aware LLM Scheduling for Real-World Workloads
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Agentic applications generate multi-turn sequences of LLM requests, with each new turn extending the context accumulated from prior interactions and tool calls.

Agentic applications generate multi-turn sequences of LLM requests, with each new turn extending the context accumulated from prior interactions and tool calls. Prefix caching reuses the KV cache of earlier turns and avoids redundant prefill, but routing every turn to its cache-affine instance can create severe local queues while capacity remains idle elsewhere. Remote KV cache access relaxes this tension, yet migrating execution adds transfer work and is harmful when the cluster is already congested. Thus, deciding where to execute a request requires reasoning jointly about cache locality, queueing, and the current operating point of the cluster. We present Vesta, a queueing-aware scheduler for distributed agentic LLM serving. Vesta assigns each session a stable holder for its authoritative KV cache while independently selecting an executor for every request. Grounded in classical queueing theory, its objective accounts for backlog, reusable prefixes, KV cache transfer, and the queueing externality of additional service demand; it migrates execution to recover idle capacity when beneficial and favors placements that add the least prefill and transfer work as congestion rises. item.description:

Large-scale repositories of wearable sensor data have enabled the development of foundation models for human activities and behavior.

Large-scale repositories of wearable sensor data have enabled the development of foundation models for human activities and behavior. However, existing models are pretrained using fixed input durations and sampling rates, despite substantial heterogeneity in recording conditions, downstream tasks, and deployment constraints. We introduce VarMAE, a variable input masked autoencoder that learns a single representation across sampling rates and temporal contexts. During pretraining we construct two views of the same signal: a long duration high frequency view, and a short duration lower frequency view, obtained via random cropping and downsampling. We perform masked reconstruction within each view and introduce a cross-resolution masked reconstruction objective that uses visible tokens from the long view to predict masked tokens from the short view. Cropping and downsampling impose complementary information bottlenecks, encouraging the model to learn representations that remain effective across input durations and sampling rate changes. item.title: VH-GPO: Verified Handoff for LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Group-relative reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO train large language model (LLM) agents by comparing rollouts for the same task.

Group-relative reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO train large language model (LLM) agents by comparing rollouts for the same task. When every trajectory in a group fails with the same reward, relative advantages collapse toward zero, leaving no useful learning signal. A frozen teacher can recover from a student-visited state, but letting it complete the task makes the recovered suffix entirely teacher-generated. We ask: after repairing a student failure, when should control return to the student? We propose outcome-verified teacher-student handoff, instantiated in Verified Handoff for Group Policy Optimization (VH-GPO). The teacher provides enough support to reach a state from which the student can succeed, then returns control so that successful experience is again student-generated. Given an environment-verified teacher recovery, VH-GPO selects the earliest independently confirmed handoff point found within a bounded search budget. With Qwen2.5-1.5B, VH-GPO increases success rates over GRPO from 59.38% to 94.79% on ALFWorld and from 71.62% to 77.34% on WebShop. Improvements also hold with the 7B student, for which additional teacher and student output tokens amount to 1.…

item.title: Understanding the Power Consumption of Modern High Bandwidth Memory: Experimental Analysis and Modeling Using Real HBM2 DRAM Chips
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

We perform the first comprehensive experimental characterization of power consumed by real HBM2 DRAM chips.

We perform the first comprehensive experimental characterization of power consumed by real HBM2 DRAM chips. Our extensive characterization yields 1) the empirical basis for developing new, accurate HBM power models or validating existing power models and 2) key insights into structural and data-pattern-dependent variation of power in HBM2 chips. Out of our 13 new findings and 6 key takeaway messages, we highlight: 1) a read operation consumes significantly higher current than any other operation and 2) the toggled data bus signals in a data transfer burst significantly affect current draw where toggling all HBM2-internal bank group bus signals causes 29.4% higher power consumption than keeping them constant. Leveraging our empirical insights into HBM2 power consumption, we engineer an access pattern that yields 23.6% higher power consumption on average across 36 tested HBM2 chips than the highest-power-consuming JEDEC-specified current measurement loop. Our results have important implications for HBM-based system design and validation. item.description:

Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models have emerged as powerful generative priors across domains ranging from molecular design to high-resolution image synthesis.

Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models have emerged as powerful generative priors across domains ranging from molecular design to high-resolution image synthesis. However, standard diffusion sampling is inherently biased toward high-likelihood regions, often limiting the diversity of outputs. In many domains, a single, high-likelihood sample is insufficient. Instead, diverse portfolios of high-performing solutions are required, motivating methods that uncover a model's full expressive range. Here we show that integrating Quality-Diversity (QD) optimisation with diffusion models enables the discovery of diverse, high-performing outputs. We first propose Quality-Diversity Diffusion, a framework that adapts QD to diffusion models by directly optimising the model's latent noise and conditioning embeddings and leveraging embedding models to quantify diversity. Second, we introduce a novel h-space Spectral Mutation operator, which guides search along directions of maximal semantic sensitivity by analysing principal singular vectors of the model's input-to-activation Jacobian. item.title: ULPack: Reference-Conditioned Lossless Compression of Checkpoint Trajectories
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Studying model training requires checkpoint trajectories, whose storage cost limits temporal resolution.

Studying model training requires checkpoint trajectories, whose storage cost limits temporal resolution. Although adjacent checkpoints are numerically close, existing lossless codecs either operate on XOR bit patterns or ignore trajectory-specific conditional structure. We show that a reference weight's exponent predicts the bit length of its displacement in ordered floating-point space without side information. We introduce \textbf{ULPack}, a lossless codec which exploits this dependence by conditioning entropy models of ordered-integer residuals on the reference exponent. Across bfloat16, float16, and float32 trajectories, ULPack reduces storage by up to 27\% against ZipNN, 21\% against zstd-19, and 11.5\% against FM-Delta. Across two dense trajectories, compression improves as updates shrink and reference conditioning strengthens, while near uniform low-order bits set the remaining compression floor and earlier checkpoints add little information.

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Settling one comparison between two truncation samplers has cost six thousand A100-hours, and nothing says in advance how far apart two samplers can be.

Settling one comparison between two truncation samplers has cost six thousand A100-hours, and nothing says in advance how far apart two samplers can be. We observe that almost every deployed truncation rule keeps a prefix of the probability-sorted vocabulary, so any two such rules are nested at every decoding step. Nesting yields a closed-form per-step distance and a coupling under which both samplers emit identical text until they first disagree. Accumulated over a generation, this gives a separation certificate that bounds the difference between two samplers on any bounded outcome, is computable from logs a comparison already produces, and equals their sequence-level total variation distance exactly when neither rule ever overtakes the other. Two consequences follow without measurement: exactness is fragile, and certifying a small difference requires the two retained masses to agree to very high precision at every step. On six open-weight models over four math and science benchmarks, the certificate for every hyperparameter grid we tested is at least 0.998, so a bound alone rarely settles a comparison, although two members of one family can be far closer. 发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) increases developer productivity by removing operational concerns such as managing hardware and software runtimes.

Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) increases developer productivity by removing operational concerns such as managing hardware and software runtimes. Because function instances are started on demand, some requests must wait for a new instance, called a cold start. These are a common obstacle to more widespread adoption of FaaS, as they lead to unpredictable latency spikes that are not acceptable for some use cases. To solve this, many cold start optimizations have been implemented. However, comparatively little attention has been directed towards the slowest warm starts. With improvements in cold start times, slow warm starts emerge as a new problem for extreme tail events. By analyzing a dataset of several million requests across seven FaaS platforms, we show that the long tail of slow warm starts can be hundreds of times slower than their median performance, while a virtual machine we use as a baseline is substantially more consistent. We confirm this across four independent public datasets spanning 2020 to 2025, so the effect is neither new nor specific to one platform. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 量化降内存已知，但量化推理对能耗与碳强度的影响缺乏系统定量研究。

方法 首个统一评测：5 个模型（Llama 2 7B、Phi 3.5 Mini、OLMo 1B、Qwen 2.5 7B/14B）× 4 数据集 × 10 种 PTQ 策略 × 4 款 GPU（H100/A6000/A100/L4），在不同输入输出长度下比较能效、精度损失与运行时间。

关键数字 输入足够长、输出短时量化相对全精度的能效收益最大；批增大带来的能效提升有限；EETQ int8、Bitsandbytes int8 等融合内核最省电，短文本生成较 FP32 最高省 4 倍且精度损失可忽略；能耗与运行时间高度同步。

为什么值得看 首份 weight-only 量化能效统一评测，"优化时延≈减碳"的结论对绿色 AI 实践有直接指导性。

item.title: Toward a Multimodal Foundation Model for Plasma State Reconstruction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Plasma experiments observe coupled physical states through sparse, heterogeneous, and incomplete diagnostics.

Plasma experiments observe coupled physical states through sparse, heterogeneous, and incomplete diagnostics. We present a proof of concept toward a multimodal foundation model for plasma state reconstruction during magnetic reconnection, motivated by the Facility for Laboratory Reconnection Experiments (FLARE). Using 250 synthetic VPIC simulations at fixed reference electron beta $β_{e0}=0.2$, with 225 training runs and 25 disjoint validation runs, we train a 5.5M-parameter residual 3D U-Net to reconstruct three magnetic-field components and electron density from incomplete observations. The model combines spatial-only pooling, which preserves all 24 temporal frames, with global spatiotemporal self-attention and rotary positional encoding. Independently masking magnetic and density modalities across random, grid, block, and temporal patterns enables sparse sensing, cross-modal completion, density super-resolution, and temporal completion with a single set of weights and no task-specific retraining. item.title: To Defer or Not to Defer? Online Learning with LLMs and Congested Experts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Modern AI systems increasingly combine large language models (LLMs) with human experts, using the LLM to handle routine queries while deferring uncertain cases for expert review.

Modern AI systems increasingly combine large language models (LLMs) with human experts, using the LLM to handle routine queries while deferring uncertain cases for expert review. When expert capacity is limited, however, deferral decisions must account not only for the reliability of the LLM but also for congestion in the expert queue. We formulate this as an online sequential decision-making problem in which, for each query, the system observes the confidence signal of the LLM's answer and must decide whether to output the answer or defer the query to a capacity-constrained expert. The reliability of the confidence signal is initially unknown and must be learned from expert feedback, which is both selectively observed (only deferred queries are labeled) and delayed by queuing. We propose \texttt{KL-PBD}, a learning algorithm that uses Kullback--Leibler lower confidence bounds on the unknown reliability parameters to guide deferral decisions. For $K$ confidence levels and horizon $T$, \texttt{KL-PBD} achieves $O(K\log T)$ gap-dependent regret when the accuracy at every confidence level is bounded away from the deferral boundary, and $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{KT})$ worst-case regret. Cross-model KV cache sharing reduces prefill computation by allowing a receiver model to reuse prefix KV states generated by a related sender model.

Cross-model KV cache sharing reduces prefill computation by allowing a receiver model to reuse prefix KV states generated by a related sender model. Existing methods optimize such reuse for latency and generation quality, but its safety implications remain unclear. In this work, we systematically evaluate this issue across diverse sender-receiver pairs and reuse configurations. We refer to deviations from the receiver's native safety behavior as safety incompatibility. Our study shows that both the direction and magnitude of safety incompatibility depend on the model pair and reuse configuration, with value reuse causing substantially larger deviations than key reuse across all evaluated pairs. Furthermore, we propose VReparo, a technique that learns per-layer and per-KV-head affine maps offline to align reused sender value tensors with their receiver-native counterparts before decoding. item.title: Tiny Recursive Message Passing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Message passing neural networks have shown remarkable performance in algorithmic and constraint reasoning, due to their ability to encode the structure of the task directly in the architecture.

Message passing neural networks have shown remarkable performance in algorithmic and constraint reasoning, due to their ability to encode the structure of the task directly in the architecture. Recent work has shown that better results can be achieved using recursive transformers trained with deep supervision and truncated recursions, which make extremely deep loops stable to train, and equipped with test-time procedures such as discrete deduction lattices. In this work, we apply the same procedures to message passing networks, and show that the two ingredients are complementary, and lead to parameter efficient models: we obtain about $99\%$ test accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme with a model of $16$k parameters that trains in about $10$ minutes on an H100, or in $9$ hours on a CPU. We further show that the cost of truncating gradients grows with the number of rounds information needs to cross the graph, making the choice of wiring a trade-off between robustness to truncation and transfer across problem sizes. Language model (LM) agents can fail for different reasons, requiring different explanations and interventions.

Language model (LM) agents can fail for different reasons, requiring different explanations and interventions. We study how state beliefs, action values, and action preferences interact as LM agents reason and commit to decisions in text-rendered grid worlds. We estimate task-relevant beliefs using report-based and representation-based probes, and action values using inverse reinforcement learning. We find that task-relevant state and value information is often represented more reliably than it is reflected in behaviour. Tracking action preferences throughout reasoning further shows that decisions sharpen around a commitment point and reported belief uncertainty decreases near commitment, although individual belief changes do not consistently explain shifts in action preference. Finally, forced actions follow reasoning prefixes from other decisions when transplanted, whereas the tested reasoning-window activation edits provide limited control over the action. Together, these results suggest that some failures arise not from missing task-relevant information, but from how available information is translated into action. item.title: The Price of Precision: A Calibrated Cost Model for Mixed-Precision LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Choosing a mixed-precision configuration for large language model (LLM) serving trades speed against accuracy.

Choosing a mixed-precision configuration for large language model (LLM) serving trades speed against accuracy. Allocators that use average bit-width or a memory budget as a speed proxy can miss changes in the resource that limits execution. We argue that served speed can be limited by compute, weight loading, or key-value (KV) cache access, depending on the phase, batch size, and context length. A byte-based proxy does not capture all of these costs, so fewer bits do not always mean faster serving. To address this gap, we build a cost model that accounts for the binding resource and use it in two ways. First, as a predictor: given a configuration and operating point, it estimates serving latency using constants calibrated for the model, GPU, and serving stack. We evaluate its accuracy across three hardware classes. Second, as an allocator: we combine modeled time costs with measured per-tensor accuracy costs and use a dynamic program to select a configuration under a latency or accuracy budget. We compare its configurations against byte-aware and sensitivity-only allocation.

item.title: The Gradient That Top-k Distillation Never Computes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Many deployed distillation pipelines show the student a truncated view of the teacher: keep the top-k probabilities, renormalize, and minimize a divergence on what remains.

Many deployed distillation pipelines show the student a truncated view of the teacher: keep the top-k probabilities, renormalize, and minimize a divergence on what remains. Renormalization is assumed to account for the missing mass. We prove that it removes the visibility of tail mass, not the freedom to move it. The renormalized objective depends only on log-odds among the retained tokens, so at each position its gradient along the directions that control tail mass is exactly zero; on a real teacher that component measures $2$-$3\times10^{-15}$ of the gradient. The full-vocabulary gradient equals the truncated gradient plus a residual weighted by the tail masses, and training acts only on the first term. Without the cross-entropy term, a top-k student's tail mass drifts away from the teacher's while a full-vocabulary control moves slightly toward it; with it, the gap shrinks about fourfold but persists. On seven open-weight teachers, the retained set determines the teacher's distribution only from $k=d+1$ ($d$ the hidden dimension): recovery is exact from there on all seven, and commonly cached sizes sit below it. In our off-policy runs the practical effect is real but smaller tha…

Many deployed distillation pipelines show the student a truncated view of the teacher: keep the top-k probabilities, renormalize, and minimize a divergence on what remains.

Many deployed distillation pipelines show the student a truncated view of the teacher: keep the top-k probabilities, renormalize, and minimize a divergence on what remains. Renormalization is assumed to account for the missing mass. We prove that it removes the visibility of tail mass, not the freedom to move it. The renormalized objective depends only on log-odds among the retained tokens, so at each position its gradient along the directions that control tail mass is exactly zero; on a real teacher that component measures $2$-$3\times10^{-15}$ of the gradient. The full-vocabulary gradient equals the truncated gradient plus a residual weighted by the tail masses, and training acts only on the first term. Without the cross-entropy term, a top-k student's tail mass drifts away from the teacher's while a full-vocabulary control moves slightly toward it; with it, the gap shrinks about fourfold but persists. On seven open-weight teachers, the retained set determines the teacher's distribution only from $k=d+1$ ($d$ the hidden dimension): recovery is exact from there on all seven, and commonly cached sizes sit below it. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

LLM agents now write their own schematic and layout generators, run EDA tools, read the results, and fix the design.

LLM agents now write their own schematic and layout generators, run EDA tools, read the results, and fix the design. This "vibe tapeout" is becoming practical for analog circuits as well. This paper measures how far it has come in two settings. (A) On an open PDK (SKY130), a cloud LLM agent designed an 11-bit, 5.12-MS/s SAR ADC from its specification. The agents produced DRC- and LVS-clean macros and met the specification after parasitic extraction (PEX). In particular, under the condition in which the agent received a sanitized reference design derived from our 65-nm design (vibe porting), it produced the best layout in the shortest time. Its area was 1/1.6 to 1/2.8 of that of the conditions without a reference. This condition reached signoff without human intervention. The agents also identified the causes of post-PEX degradation (CDAC wiring coupling and common-mode-dependent comparator offset) by their own experiments. On the other hand, agents sometimes reported false passes, and verification independent of the design agent was essential. (B) A commercial PDK is under NDA and cannot be given to a cloud LLM. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

External tools can extend the capabilities of small language models (SLMs), enabling their deployment in resource constrained environments.

External tools can extend the capabilities of small language models (SLMs), enabling their deployment in resource constrained environments. However, their limited capabilities make it difficult for SLMs to discover effective tool use behaviors through reinforcement learning alone, while direct teacher supervision suffers from teacher student behavioral distribution mismatch and may propagate erroneous preferences. To address these challenges, we propose Selective Teacher guided Policy Optimization (SeTPO), which coordinates student exploration with selective teacher guidance and persistent demonstration supervision. Specifically, SeTPO incorporates reverse KL derived token level teacher feedback into policy advantages on low reward trajectories, while auxiliary forward KL supervision preserves teacher demonstrated behaviors throughout training. Under an idealized bidirectional KL objective, we theoretically establish that the optimal policy achieves expected reward no lower than the teacher's while retaining a guaranteed fraction of the teacher's probability mass. item.description:

On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a popular training paradigm for LLMs, providing dense, token-level supervision by aligning a model's own distribution with the distribution induced by privileged information.

On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a popular training paradigm for LLMs, providing dense, token-level supervision by aligning a model's own distribution with the distribution induced by privileged information. However, existing OPSD methods derive supervision solely from privileged information of the same instance, leaving inter-instance supervision largely unexplored. We propose Lookahead Self-Distillation (LEAD), which introduces inter-instance distillation by allowing the teacher to first learn from other on-policy rollouts before teaching the student. LEAD constructs lookahead teachers through virtual RL updates on disjoint subsets of on-policy rollouts, and uses each teacher to provide cross-group token-level supervision for the other subset. To reconcile the complementary yet potentially conflicting signals from OPSD and RLVR, we introduce harmonious modulation, which adaptively modulates the GRPO advantage based on the agreement between the two signals. 发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Generative modeling for tabular data has advanced to the point where models can synthesize realistic records, recover missing values, and generate samples conditioned on class labels or observed attributes.

Generative modeling for tabular data has advanced to the point where models can synthesize realistic records, recover missing values, and generate samples conditioned on class labels or observed attributes. Despite recent advances, existing approaches either require table-specific training or restrict in-context learning to single-cell prediction. In this work, we formulate these tabular generative tasks as a single problem: modeling the joint conditional distribution of an arbitrary set of target cells given the observed cells of an unseen table. To this end, we turn to diffusion, whose denoising objective is defined jointly over all target cells rather than one cell at a time. Under the pretraining distribution, this objective is minimized by the posterior predictive distribution over the target set. Building on this, we propose TabMosaic, a unified in-context diffusion model for generating mixed-type target cells in unseen, potentially incomplete tables without table-specific training. We further show that its pretraining objective bounds the conditional negative log-likelihood and the divergence from the posterior predictive for arbitrary target sets, extending the Bayesian acc…

Tabular data generation aims to synthesize realistic samples from limited observations while faithfully capturing the underlying data distribution.

Tabular data generation aims to synthesize realistic samples from limited observations while faithfully capturing the underlying data distribution. Tabular foundation models (TFMs), pretrained on diverse tabular tasks and adapted through in-context learning, have demonstrated strong predictive capabilities, suggesting the potential of extending this paradigm to tabular data generation. However, the strong predictive performance of TFMs often relies on sufficiently large context sets, whereas tabular generation is typically needed precisely when target data are scarce. Extending the foundation-model paradigm to generation therefore requires reliable distribution inference from only a limited context. To this end, we propose TabGift, a context-efficient tabular foundation model enabling both efficient distribution modeling and effective generation from only a few context samples. TabGift maps heterogeneous tables into a shared latent space with a pretrained tabular encoder, where an in-context diffusion model learns to denoise latent samples conditioned on a small set of clean examples. item.title: TPPO: Tracking-Value PPO For Language Model Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for language-model reasoning.

Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for language-model reasoning. While \emph{value evolution along trajectory} characterizes relative token-level credit, yet standard critics often fail to track it under sparse terminal rewards. To model this evolution, we analyze the relation between successive prefix values and show that they admit a Bayesian decomposition with additive updates in log-odds space. We use this additive structure to construct Tracking-Value PPO (\method), a cumulative value parameterization that sums position-wise scalar outputs into value logits. These outputs are learned through terminal-outcome supervision on the reconstructed values. \method improves aggregate mathematical reasoning scores over PPO by 7.0 and 8.4 points on Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, respectively, while improving out-of-distribution generalization. Gains extend to Qwen3-4B, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen3.5-9B and to countdown, and scientific coding tasks. Further analysis shows more accurate tracking of value evolution and more reliable advantage estimates. Our code is publicly available in https://github.com/LINs-lab/TPPO.

item.title: TLA-Verus: Generating and Solving Temporal Proof Obligations with LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

The TLA+ (temporal logic of actions) formal specification toolkit has seen widespread adoption in modeling modern distributed software systems including databases, storage systems, ledgers and coordination protocols.

The TLA+ (temporal logic of actions) formal specification toolkit has seen widespread adoption in modeling modern distributed software systems including databases, storage systems, ledgers and coordination protocols. This popularity is despite its two significant limitations for software verification: Firstly, TLA+ offers no way to detect drift between software implementation and mathematical specification; secondly, TLC and TLAPS cannot provide satisfactory proofs of arbitrary temporal logic properties. We take a step towards addressing these shortcomings by translating TLA+ specifications into Verus, an auto-active verifier built for Rust, via both a deterministic transpiler and an agentic translator. We demonstrate that our LLM-based pipeline is able to generate proof obligations from TLA+ specifications at scale, and to produce fully machine checkable proofs of both safety and liveness properties. Since temporal logic reasoning in Verus is a largely new task for LLMs, our work yields a valuable evaluation dataset, which we use to map out current generation model capabilities in Verus theorem proving.

item.title: TILE: Bridging LLMs and Table Foundation Models for Tabular Learning with Strings
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Real-world tables are often heterogeneous, combining numerical features with free-form string columns.

Real-world tables are often heterogeneous, combining numerical features with free-form string columns. Table foundation models (TFMs) excel on numerical tables but require strings to be encoded numerically, while large language models (LLMs) hold semantic knowledge but are not designed for tabular predictions. Most existing bridges use LLMs as plug-in encoders for cell strings, yet how to extract representations effectively for tabular learning remains underexplored. We show that the interface between LLMs and tables matter as much as the LLM itself. Applied cell-wise, larger LLMs do not give better features. With our interface, the same LLMs improve steadily with size. TILE (Table-Interfaced LLM Embeddings) combines four ingredients: row serialization to provide cross-column context, intermediate-layer extraction to avoid layers specialized for next-token prediction, columnar pooling to remove mean pooling's length bias, and by-pass features to route numbers and categories past the LLM. Paired with TFMs, TILE sets a new state of the art for tables with strings. Across 100 datasets, it beats the strongest baseline on 89% of splits, with gains across 7 LLMs and 10 tabular learners, …

item.title: Swarm Telepathy: Prefill-Free KV-Cache Transfer Across Families
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

LLM multi-agent systems split work across agents that communicate through text.

LLM multi-agent systems split work across agents that communicate through text. An agent summarizes its findings, another agent receives the text. This constrains communication to discrete tokens and costs redundant compute, limiting bandwidth and capabilities of multi-agent systems. Recent works demonstrate KV-cache transfer between LLMs but they either require the LLMs to be within the same family or cannot function across context, thus requiring the receiver to prefill text. We present SwaT (Swarm Telepathy), the first cross-family KV-cache transfer method that allows prefill-free communication in multi-family multi-agent systems. In an agent-to-agent communication setting, combining SwaT with recent advances in KV-cache compaction beats text-to-text communication in both accuracy and speed, with a mean of $40\%$ higher accuracy and a mean of $4\times$ faster wall-clock time. Experiments show SwaT achieves high performance on 17 benchmarks across 12 LLMs and 6 families. Additionally, given a sender Vision-Language Model (VLM), SwaT is able to transfer the vision capabilities to a text-only receiver LLM exceeding text-to-text communication despite SwaT being trained on text-only …

item.title: Substep Linearizability: Relaxing Atomicity While Preserving Sequential Specification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Linearizability is a standard correctness condition for concurrent objects.It takes a correct by construction sequential specification of a concurrent data structure, and produces a composable specification under atomic interleavings of operations.

Linearizability is a standard correctness condition for concurrent objects. It takes a correct by construction sequential specification of a concurrent data structure, and produces a composable specification under atomic interleavings of operations. However, some operations like atomic exchangers are not specifiable atomically, making it difficult to reason compositionally about their specifications. Interval linearizability is the state of the art in relaxing linearizability's constraints. Formally it is a powerful framework, but it requires an interval-sequential specification of the target data structure, which we show is challenging to correctly generate or understand, even for simple operations on a single concurrent register. We propose substep linearizability, which we show is equivalent to interval linearizability using X-CCorrectness, a relaxed concurrency framework we created to compare existing linearizability semantics. We show that substep linearizability's sequential specifications are suitable for previously infeasible specification tasks, while being comparable in complexity to linearizability's sequential specifications. For evaluation, we model an atomic exchanger…

Machine learning surrogates of partial differential equations (PDEs) are commonly trained on data generated by numerical solvers.

Machine learning surrogates of partial differential equations (PDEs) are commonly trained on data generated by numerical solvers. Therefore, the training data obey not the PDE but the modified equation of the numerical scheme, and the test loss, computed on data from the same solver, cannot distinguish a model that learned the physics from one that learned the discretization error. Here, we show that the difference is nevertheless visible in the trained model. We propose a suite of structure-preserving fidelity diagnostics, simple scores that measure whether a learned model respects one known property of the physics, such as a conserved quantity, a symmetry or a Hamiltonian structure, without access to the training data or the governing equation. Over five systems, the diagnostics track the error with respect to the true dynamics with a rank correlation of up to $0.94$, while the test loss is uncorrelated or anti-correlated with it. For the Burgers, Korteweg-de Vries and Navier-Stokes equations, the diagnostics separate numerical schemes that the test loss ranks as equivalent, including schemes of the same order. order.

Fine-tuning large language models at scale is increasingly limited by the memory cost of backpropagation.

Fine-tuning large language models at scale is increasingly limited by the memory cost of backpropagation. Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimizers reduce this burden by relying only on forward function evaluations, but they still exhibit a substantial performance gap to first-order (FO) optimizers such as Adam. We argue that this gap does not arise solely from the absence of explicit gradients: FO fine-tuning also benefits from informative low-rank optimization geometry, large-scale signal aggregation, and well-conditioned update directions. Motivated by this, we introduce StructZO, a structured Zeroth-Order optimization framework for memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning. StructZO performs large-query ZO estimation within an activation-induced informative subspace and applies spectral control to the resulting reduced-space update before mapping it back to the original parameters. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Thermodynamic computing lets stochastic physical dynamics carry out a computation and reads out the result as a time average.

Thermodynamic computing lets stochastic physical dynamics carry out a computation and reads out the result as a time average. Recently, thermodynamic computing has been demonstrated on several hardware platforms, including digital CMOS circuits based on stochastic computing. Superconducting single-flux-quantum (SFQ) logic offers very high clock rates and very low switching energy, but it heavily penalizes state, memory, fan-out, and feedback, i.e., exactly the per-neuron accumulators on which such designs rely. We therefore realize thermodynamic computing in SFQ logic through a co-design of a generative model and its circuit in which the datapath holds no state at all. The model is a class-conditional flow-matching image generator, which transforms Gaussian noise into an image of the requested class along a short, deterministic path of four Euler steps; in hardware, these steps are unrolled into a feed-forward pipeline of stochastic bitstream operators, whose output is read out as a time average, as in thermodynamic computing, without any relaxation phase. item.title: StageBreaker: Shifting Video RL Post-Training Scheduling from Stages down to Data Dependencies
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has emerged as the key paradigm for improving autoregressive video models.

Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has emerged as the key paradigm for improving autoregressive video models. Emerging vision-language reward models further strengthen post-training with accurate rewards, but their long chain-of-thought inference substantially raises the associated costs, while the pursuit of long videos prolongs policy training. Despite these rising costs, existing video RL systems still adopt coarse-grained stage-centric execution, which stalls policy training until all reward evaluation finishes, replays every trajectory twice due to a further barrier within policy training, and induces load imbalance across GPUs. To address the challenges, we propose StageBreaker, a fine-grained data-dependency-driven scheduling framework, which schedules the true dataflow of an RL step rather than its stages. Specifically, StageBreaker overlaps policy training with reward evaluation by exploiting reward-separable policy training, and merges the two trajectory replays into one by leveraging loss-independent back-propagation. It further balances GPU load by scheduling computation at the finer granularity. Our evaluation results show that StageBreaker achieves a speedup of…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Continual learning (CL) adapts pretrained models to a sequence of tasks while retaining knowledge acquired from earlier tasks.

Continual learning (CL) adapts pretrained models to a sequence of tasks while retaining knowledge acquired from earlier tasks. When task data are sensitive, differential privacy (DP) provides record-level protection, but maintaining both adaptation and retention under privacy constraints remains challenging. We study this problem in continual low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and observe that: 1) private training increases forgetting primarily during subsequent adaptation rather than initial task acquisition; 2) jointly perturbing both LoRA factors introduces a non-negligible bilinear noise interaction; and 3) DP aggravates the stability-plasticity dilemma, hindering both knowledge retention and adaptation to new tasks. Based on these observations, we propose DP-SPA, which constructs a stable subspace from previously privatized updates and a plastic subspace from pretrained weights within its orthogonal complement. The method fixes these bases and privately optimizes only the LoRA factor, eliminating the bilinear noise interaction within each step. item.title: Sparsity Saves Compute, Not Samples: Oracle Inequalities for Dense and Sparse Mixture of Experts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine specialized experts through an input-dependent routing mechanism, and their sparse variants underpin many modern large-scale systems.

Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine specialized experts through an input-dependent routing mechanism, and their sparse variants underpin many modern large-scale systems. Yet the statistical cost of adaptive routing remains only partially understood. We study the estimation error of least-squares MoE estimators when both the experts and the gating network are Lipschitz in their parameters. We represent each MoE as a gate--expert pair in a Gated Hilbert Space, whose norm $\|\cdot\|_Δ$ separates the contributions of routing and expert discrepancies. Using its empirical representation, we derive an oracle inequality with a fast rate of order $\tilde{\mathcal O}\big((Kd_{\mathrm{pr},e}+d_{\mathrm{pr},g})/n\big)$ for dense MoEs with $K$ experts. For sparse Top-$k$ and Top-$p$ routing, the selection map is discontinuous in the gating parameters. We handle this by partitioning the gating class according to the selection patterns it induces on the sample. The resulting bounds match the dense rate up to an additive routing cost governed by the Natarajan dimension of the selector. We show that such a routing-complexity condition cannot be dropped: Lipschitz continuity in the parameters al…

item.title: Sparse-TD-JEPA: Improving Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning With Sparse Latent Task Representations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Successor-feature-based zero-shot reinforcement learning methods pre-train a task encoder and successor-feature predictor on offline, reward-free data, then recover a policy at test time by solving a closed-form linear regression over a small labeled dataset.

Successor-feature-based zero-shot reinforcement learning methods pre-train a task encoder and successor-feature predictor on offline, reward-free data, then recover a policy at test time by solving a closed-form linear regression over a small labeled dataset. We identify an underexplored limitation of this approach: when the task encoder produces dense representations, the inferred reward signal becomes diffuse across the state space, reducing the contrast between goal-relevant states and the background and providing a weaker signal for the policy to follow. We address this limitation by introducing an l1 sparsity penalty that concentrates reward-predictive structure into a smaller effective subspace of the task encoder's latent space. The penalty is applied only during training and requires no architectural change or modification to the closed-form inference procedure. We instantiate this approach as Sparse-TD-JEPA, a single-line of code addition based on Temporal-Difference Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (TD-JEPA) that significantly improved its performance in zero-shot reinforcement learning. We evaluate Sparse-TD-JEPA on 65 tasks across the DeepMind Control (DMC) Suite…

item.description:

The fusion of artificial intelligence (AI) and space technologies is extending spaceborne intelligence beyond onboard payloads toward a global infrastructure, here termed Space AI infrastructure (SpaceAI-Infra).

The fusion of artificial intelligence (AI) and space technologies is extending spaceborne intelligence beyond onboard payloads toward a global infrastructure, here termed Space AI infrastructure (SpaceAI-Infra). Its promise rests on two distinctive advantages of space systems: abundant solar energy in orbit and the global reach of satellite constellations. Realizing this promise hinges on a fundamental systems question: How should satellite constellations be designed and orchestrated to deliver data-center-scale AI services competitive with their terrestrial counterparts? This article develops a roadmap-oriented answer. We first chart the evolution of SpaceAI-Infra through three progressive stages: onboard AI, Space Edge AI, and Space Cloud AI. By revisiting the space-constrained fundamentals for end-to-end token services, we derive enabling design principles and translate them into an integrated space edge--cloud architecture. The communication-centric space edge comprises free-flying LEO constellations that provide user-proximate computing and form the access and backhaul fabric for cloud AI services. item.title: Softmax-Free Attention in Spiking Transformers as the Zero-Temperature Limit of Two-Level Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Spiking Transformers achieve energy efficiency by discarding softmax normalization in favor of thresholded, binary attention.

Spiking Transformers achieve energy efficiency by discarding softmax normalization in favor of thresholded, binary attention. However, this removal breaks the thermodynamic framework used to analyze attention networks, as the normalized measure and partition function cease to exist. We restore this theoretical foundation by proving that softmax-free spiking attention operates exactly as the zero-temperature limit of a product of independent two-level systems. This correspondence places spiking attention strictly in the frozen ordered phase of the thermodynamic phase diagram for all inputs. Consequently, the entropic cost of organizing attention collapses, replaced by a Landauer-type physical floor governed by action-potential generation. Furthermore, this ordered-phase pinning mathematically explains the optimization difficulty caused by vanishing surrogate gradients. We validate this theory with forward-relaxation experiments, placing both standard and neuromorphic attention mechanisms on a unified thermodynamic axis.

Descriptions of how people use AI are becoming training data for the next generation of models.

Descriptions of how people use AI are becoming training data for the next generation of models. We ask whether what a model reads about its users changes how it treats people. Using contrastive synthetic-document finetuning, we train Qwen3-32B on four matched corpora built from the same 1,625 real-world usage scenarios. The corpora differ only in the predominant motive they attribute to users of AI chatbots: helping others (prosocial), exploiting others (antisocial), legitimate self-advancement, or task completion. Finetuning shifts the models' stated beliefs about users, how true those beliefs look along an internal truth direction, and their broader judgments of how safe and good the world is. These social priors carry into behavior. In trust games, antisocial models expect less reciprocity and send less money than prosocial models. Their distrust is specific and targeted at people, and users of AI chatbots in particular. After an exploitative record, they send almost nothing to a person but most of their endowment to a random device with the same record. item.title: SoK: Rethinking Membership Inference in Tabular Machine Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) are currently the dominant approach to evaluating privacy in machine learning applications.

Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) are currently the dominant approach to evaluating privacy in machine learning applications. Despite their significance, several concerns remain unexplored, particularly with regard to tabular data. Existing evaluations focus predominantly on high-dimensional datasets, leaving the privacy behavior of small-to-medium datasets unexplored. In this paper, we present a new taxonomy for MIAs and conduct a comprehensive study of the factors influencing vulnerability. We evaluate four distinct state-of-the-art attacks across diverse tabular datasets and model architectures. Our results show that datasets with higher class granularity and majority class percentage are more susceptible to MIAs. We further demonstrate that advanced MIAs are highly dependent on adversarial knowledge of the target model, while reference model-free attacks often achieve statistically comparable results. Most importantly, we show that records with unique signatures (single-outs) remain highly vulnerable, even when common defenses are applied. These findings indicate that current defenses reduce average leakage, but fail to adequately protect the most sensitive individuals.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Simulate Before You Scale: High-Fidelity LLM Inference Planning Without GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 推理规模化部署需联合选择硬件布局、并行策略、调度、准入与路由，GPU 试错昂贵，现有预测工具只建模管线片段。

方法 BLIS：纯 CPU 确定性离散事件模拟器，覆盖准入、路由、调度、prefill/decode、KV 管理与抢占全管线；解析基函数加全局拟合的学习系数预测步延迟，无需逐模型/逐 GPU 画像。

关键数字 6 模型 3 类 GPU 共 36 个实验，中位端到端误差 6.7%，比真实执行快约 200 倍；为 Llama-2-70B 搜索 420 个配置找到满足 300ms TTFT SLO 的 4-GPU 方案；模拟中演化出的准入/流控策略经真机验证并入 llm-d，关键层 TTFT P90 最多降 82%。

为什么值得看 "先模拟再扩容"省去 GPU 试错成本，策略被开源平台 llm-d 采纳，落地成色足。

Multimodal entity alignment (MMEA) is fundamental to integrating heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs), yet existing paradigms remain critically vulnerable to incomplete modalities and cross-graph structural asymmetries.

Multimodal entity alignment (MMEA) is fundamental to integrating heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs), yet existing paradigms remain critically vulnerable to incomplete modalities and cross-graph structural asymmetries. This paper exposes a fundamental oversight in current MMEA research: treating feature missingness and topological discrepancies as isolated preprocessing or denoising challenges, which overlooks their destructive coupling during multimodal fusion. We systematically formulate and evaluate two newly identified failure modes: 1) Detail Missing (DM)-induced overvaluation, where the absence of local modality details causes models to overemphasize uninformative, blurred representations; and 2) Context Imbalance (CI)-induced suppression, where topological discrepancies across KGs allow dense structural contexts to overwhelm weaker but highly discriminative modal signals, triggering high-level semantic drift. To break this cycle of degradation, we introduce ALMEA, a generative and calibration framework that establishes a bidirectional feedback loop between low-level feature reconstruction and high-level latent space alignment. item.title: ShellElastic: Scalable Elastic Pretraining with Simultaneous Maximal Updates and Hyperparameter Transfer
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-14　分类：论文PDF

Foundation models need to support diverse inference budgets, yet training a separate model for each budget duplicates pretraining effort.

Foundation models need to support diverse inference budgets, yet training a separate model for each budget duplicates pretraining effort. Elastic models train several nested sub-networks inside one weight-shared supernet, but existing recipes face three obstacles: variable per-step workloads that hinder distributed scaling, limited hyperparameter (HP) transfer across model sizes, and no guarantee that all sub-networks are maximally updated at once. We present \Ours, an elastic transformer that organizes hidden dimensions into a dense core and successive shells, so that every hidden matrix is block lower triangular. One full-width forward pass contains every sub-network's exact hidden states as prefixes, so joint training keeps a fixed computation graph and costs about as much per step as training the widest sub-network alone. We further introduce \muE, an extension of maximal update parameterization (\mup) to \Ours and other elastic architectures.
